architecture.anchor: one binary LightGBM trained on R20 target_p20_safe
architecture.residual: three-seed strongly regularized LightGBM ensemble trained with R20 logit as init_score

nested_time_training.rule: Every R20 anchor score is out-of-fold for the row it scores: an early anchor scores residual-fit rows; a fixed-iteration refit on all matured outer-fit rows scores residual-tune, calibration, and test rows
nested_time_training.label_maturity: horizon_end_date must precede the next segment start

feature_mode.name: portable
feature_mode.reason: confirmation and daily inference must reconstruct every feature without stale historical snapshots

stage_2.cross_sectional_features: percentile ranks of the top 32 anchor features selected on anchor training data only
stage_2.hybrid: fixed 50% daily percentile rank of S20-20R residual probability plus 50% daily percentile rank of LambdaRank score

stage_3_calibration.method: bounded logistic probability head on stage-1 logit and stage-2 hybrid-rank logit
stage_3_calibration.maturity_rule: a row may enter calibration only when horizon_end_date is earlier than prediction date

usable_output.selection_score: S20-20R hybrid daily percentile rank, 0-100, not a probability
usable_output.confidence_reference: R20-P20 probability, explicitly labeled as the broader R20 event probability
usable_output.rejected_output: learned S20-20R absolute probability from stage 3
usable_output.reason: R20 reference probability error on S20-selected Top20 stayed below 5pp in every development fold

new_confirmation.state: opened once and closed after failed stability gates; must not be reused for promotion
new_confirmation.universe: all SH/SZ non-ST rows with complete 20-session labels

production_training_mode_if_promoted.calibration_update: weekly using only matured D+20 labels
